source: M. D. White, H. H. Hoover, H. W. Garris, Flying Qualities and Stalling Characteristics of North American XP-51 Airplane, NACA MR (Wartime Report L-566), April 1943, Figure 10 'Static longitudinal-stability characteristics ... in cruising and gliding condition', https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19930092575, PDF page 62, read 2026-10-14
method: Points read by eye from a 220 dpi raster of the figure on its printed grid (cruise panel 19.7 px/deg, about 4.8 px/mph; glide panel 26.4 px/deg, 6.3 px/mph). Reading uncertainty about +-0.3 deg elevator and +-3 mph. Elevator trim tab 0. Airspeed is 'correct indicated airspeed', taken as equivalent airspeed (Mach <= 0.33).

units.elevator_up: deg (trailing edge up, relative to the stabilizer)
